register.name: PCI_L1SUB_CAP_HEADER_REG
register.comment: L1 Substates Extended Capability Header. L1 Substates Extended Capability Header provides capability ID, capability version and next offset value for L1 Substates.

register.name: PCI_L1SUB_CAPABILITY_REG
register.comment: L1 Substates Capability Register. This register provides extended capability of L1 Substates.

register.name: PCI_L1SUB_CONTROL1_REG
register.comment: L1 Substates Control 1 Register. This register Controls that the individual extended capability is enabled ot not.

register.name: PCI_L1SUB_CONTROL2_REG
register.comment: L1 Substates Control 2 Register. This register Controls that the individual extended capability is enabled ot not.
